admin.title: Virtual classroom · Zoom Server-to-Server
admin.description: Paste the Server-to-Server OAuth credentials of your Zoom account. They are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and never returned in plain text. If you leave them empty, the module falls back to the development stub.
admin.webhookSecretPlaceholder: (leave empty to keep the current one)
admin.webhookSecretHint: The "Secret Token" Zoom gives you when you set up your app's webhook, pointing at https://your-domain/api/v1/webhooks/zoom. Without it, the virtual classroom receives no meeting start/end events.
admin.clearConfirm: Delete the Zoom S2S credentials? New sessions will fall back to the stub.
admin.testOk: ✓ Credentials are valid. Linked to Zoom account {accountId}.
admin.testStub: ⚠ The module is using the local stub — no real credentials are configured yet.
